Container.Name: meal-planner
Container.Overview: Meal Planner by GearLogix. High-protein recipe book with macro goals, weekly meal planning, cook mode and grocery lists. Installable PWA.

Config.Name: Admin Passcode
Config.Description: Required to add, edit, delete or import recipes. Leave blank to disable the lock (not recommended if exposed outside your LAN).

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Encrypts the stored Claude API key. Use a long random string (for example: openssl rand -base64 32) and keep a copy; changing it means re-entering the API key.

Config.Name: Import on first run
Config.Description: Import The Protein Plate recipes when the database is empty
